source.original_feedback_text:
Part 1 Feedback: You represent an ontology that addresses core requirements of the assignment. You provide a class hierarchy, with a flexible model for sandwiches, decks, bread types, and a comprehensive filling taxonomy. The five properties (hasDeck, hasBaseBread, hasFilling, hasClosingBread, isOnTopOf) are appropriate, and you show a good understanding of object property characteristics (asymmetric, irreflexive for ordering). Your axioms are presented in description logic, covering structure, cardinality, and compositional constraints, and you explain their intent clearly. However, you could have expanded on property hierarchies (e.g., add sub-properties, formal inverses and deepen the discussion of cultural or practical modelling issues, with more direct referencing of the Wikipedia baseline.

Part 2 Feedback: No submission
source.notes: Marks and textual feedback were manually transcribed from the human marking record. Part 2 contains no submitted work and therefore receives zero marks. The single marker statement 'No submission' is represented as one part-level omission rather than duplicated across individual tasks. Requirement mappings were assigned conservatively.
